details: The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (CLARITY Act) is reportedly on the verge of passing in the U.S. Senate, following comments from Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent. This potential regulatory clarity has positively impacted the market, with Bitcoin climbing above $66,000 for the first time since mid-June and XRP leading gains among major cryptocurrencies, jumping over 4% to approximately $1.15. The bill aims to establish a comprehensive federal framework for digital assets, dividing oversight between the SEC and CFTC. A reported agreement by President Trump on an ethics provision helped clear a major obstacle for the bill.
title: US CLARITY Act Nears Senate Passage, Boosting XRP & Bitcoin

details: Ethereum's staking ratio has reached a new all-time high of 33.9% by mid-July 2026, representing approximately 40.7 million ETH now locked in staking contracts. This significant increase in staked Ether indicates strong network participation and a substantial portion of the circulating supply being removed from active trading, potentially reducing sell-side pressure.
title: Ethereum Staking Ratio Hits All-Time High

details: Pakistan's Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) has launched a dedicated cryptocurrency investigation unit within its National Command and Control Centre (NC3). This unit will focus on combating money laundering and terrorism financing activities conducted through virtual assets. The move is part of Pakistan's broader strategy to formalize its digital asset regulation, which also includes licensing exchanges.
title: Pakistan Establishes Crypto Investigation Unit
